messages:
hana: FYI console is showing a steady drift in quota attribution for a handful of customers after we flipped sampling=on for ingest. The burn looks like it's moving between 'standard' and 'priority' buckets.
tom: Hmm, sampling shouldn't change route attribution. Any recent SDK change that might interact with sampling?
kevin: We shipped a Python client tweak yesterday that adds `X-Route-Preference` when latency spikes to bias towards fast narrowcast. It only triggers on the 2nd retry.
hana: logs snippet: 
```
req id=abc123 tenant=beta route=std X-Route-Preference: fast
req id=abc123 tenant=beta route=std
req id=abc123 tenant=beta route=prio X-Route-Preference: fast
```
console shows the same token mapped to both std and prio buckets depending on which sampled event arrives first. Sampling window + ingest ordering causes apparent drift.
dara: This is messy for customer-facing dashboards. We either need to make sampling deterministic wrt route attribution or change SDK behavior.
tom: Quick mitigation: make ingest snapshot deterministic by preferring route in the initial event for a 5m sticky window per token. That would require a small console flag flip.
kevin: On SDK side I'd prefer removing route preference from retry path; instead send a non-attributing hint: `X-Client-Intent: fast-fallover`. That will let routing use it but not split telemetry buckets.
hana: Agreed. Also we should add a telemetry marker so we can tell when we normalized attribution (to check for false positives).
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: console/ingest/feature/telemetry-stabilizer (flagged) -> canary in us-west-2.
dara: Timeline suggestion: (1) flip console ingest flag behind feature flag today, watch dashboards for 1 hour; (2) patch py-sdk 0.9.5 to stop setting `X-Route-Preference` on retries and release minor canary tomorrow; (3) later standardize across go/ts clients.
tom: Also need a short note in the console changelog so customers understand that dashboards may smooth attribution for a few minutes when normalized.
eke: (typo) sorry ignore
kevin: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/py-client/pull/721 with tests + migration note. Patch adds opt-in config `route_preference_on_retry=False`. Example: 
```
client = RedwoodClient(..., route_preference_on_retry=False)
```
hana: good. After console canary, run the quota smoke test (burst simulation + retry flurry) and compare pre/post normalized-attribution metric.
deploy-bot: INC-2026-1108 created: quota-attribution-drift (linked runbook). Paging on-call for dashboard monitoring.
dara: Heads-up to support: if customers file tickets about "quota moving between buckets", reference INC-2026-1108 and tell them we're rolling a normalization flag and a SDK patch.
kevin: I'll coordinate the go/ts follow-ups once py canary is stable. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
